name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: June Week 2 - LED and Button
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.example: The sequence turned the LED on, waited, and turned it off.

words.definition: A pin used to control an output.
words.example: The output pin controlled the LED in the circuit.
The delay made the LED pause between blinks.

words.definition: Information that goes into a system or program.
words.example: Pressing the button sent input to the Arduino.

words.definition: What a system or program produces.
words.example: The LED was the output that showed the program worked.
HIGH turned the LED on in the test sketch.
LOW turned the LED off after the delay.

words.definition: A part the user can press.
words.example: The button started the light change when it was pressed.
